newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea Brent CFDs rally sharply, wet market quiet.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea Brent CFDs rally sharply, wet market quiet.

text.p: North Sea Brent CFDs rallied sharply on Wednesday, gaining more than ten cents on Tuesday's levels, paper traders said.
"It's really moving up fast," said one.
CFDs for next week (Feb 24-28) were bid as high as April Brent +29 cents, with the following week (Mar 3-7) talked at April +23/27.

One major bidder was a trading house also looking for early March wet Brent barrels, traders said. The trading house already holds two Brent cargoes. Bidding for physical cargoes was heard around March Brent -15 cents.
The last February loading Brent was sold this morning at March Brent -24 cents.
Brent intermonth spreads also gained ground. March/April was talked at +39/42, while April/May traded twice at +32 cents.
